extracted.intended_audience: researchers in California seeking or managing CIRM grants (investigators, awardees, research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory requirements for researchers applying to, and managing, grants from the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine (CIRM), including submission pathways and data-sharing expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application submission via Grants Management System
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants (first-time or returning awardees) must submit applications through CIRM’s Grants Management System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "Whether you’re a first-time applicant or a returning awardee, learn how to submit an application through CIRM’s Grants Management System." (Implied requirement to use the GMS for proposal submission; follow the system's instructions and processes.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Sharing and Management Plan (DSMP) requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: CIRM requires awardees of R&D awards to develop a Data Sharing and Management Plan (DSMP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "CIRM requires awardees of R&D awards to develop a Data Sharing and Management Plan (DSMP) and make data and metadata available to the broader scientific community." (Implication: DSMP must be prepared as part of an award and describe how data/metadata will be shared.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Make data and metadata publicly available
rubrics_metrics.description: Awardees must make data and metadata resulting from CIRM-funded R&D available to the broader scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "...and make data and metadata available to the broader scientific community." (CIRM expects public availability of research data/metadata as described in the DSMP; CIRM also publicly shares information about funded data in its Data Explorer dashboard.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Public disclosure via CIRM Data Explorer
rubrics_metrics.description: CIRM publicly shares information about CIRM-funded data in the Data Explorer dashboard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "CIRM publicly shares information about CIRM-funded data in the Data Explorer dashboard." (This indicates that award-related data/metadata will be discoverable through CIRM's public tools; DSMPs should account for this public reporting.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant management compliance (regulations, forms, policies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Awardees must follow CIRM regulations, submit required forms, adhere to CIRM policies, and consult FAQs when managing their grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "Find information to support with managing your CIRM grant including regulations, forms, policies, and FAQs." (Implies obligation to comply with CIRM's administrative and policy requirements during award administration.)
